$comment: The exact android15-6.6 late-load build paired with OPD2415 EX01.
The Manager certificate is supplied before compilation; its package, DER
size and SHA-256 are compiled into kernelsu.ko and the final APK is signed
with the same key. The Pad 3 device set adds checked zygote/system_server
replacement, post-zygote exact-once service receipts, Vector adaptation,
and a root-private hash/inode-pinned ksud handoff on top of common.
